ValidationRule.description: This rule will ensure that 'case email' is not blank if 'send closure email' checkbox is checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Owner_Manager__c )), NOT(ISCHANGED( IME_SC_Manager_of_Manager_OwnerId__c )), $RecordType.Name = "IME SC Case", ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed"), IME_SC_Send_Closure_Email__c, ISBLANK( IME_SC_Case_Email__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To send a Closure Email, either add a valid Contact to the Case, or add the Contact's email address to the Case Email field. If a Closure Email is not required uncheck Send Closure Email
